scripts.build:extension: npm run build && vite build --config extension/vite.config.mjs && cp extension/manifest.json extension/popup.html extension/popup.js extension/sidepanel.html extension/saved-page-frame.html dist/extension/
scripts.build:app: npm run build && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.format: prettier --check electron src/renderer extension/*.tsx extension/sidepanel.css vite.config.ts opencode.json eslint.config.js forge.config.cjs scripts/rename-dmg.mjs scripts/check-node-version.mjs scripts/audit-check.mjs scripts/accepted-advisories.json src/shared/cloud-contract.ts extension/cloud-client.ts cloud/src cloud/tests cloud/*.json cloud/*.yaml .github/workflows/cloud.yml scripts/check-cloud-deployment.mjs scripts/cloud-smoke.mjs scripts/bootstrap-cloud.mjs scripts/cloud-diagnose.mjs
scripts.format:write: prettier --write electron src/renderer extension/*.tsx extension/sidepanel.css vite.config.ts opencode.json eslint.config.js forge.config.cjs scripts/rename-dmg.mjs scripts/check-node-version.mjs scripts/audit-check.mjs scripts/accepted-advisories.json src/shared/cloud-contract.ts extension/cloud-client.ts cloud/src cloud/tests cloud/*.json cloud/*.yaml .github/workflows/cloud.yml scripts/check-cloud-deployment.mjs scripts/cloud-smoke.mjs scripts/bootstrap-cloud.mjs scripts/cloud-diagnose.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run build:preload && npm run build:host && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron dist/compiled/electron/main.js"
scripts.e2e:extension-demo: VITE_SOROERU_CLOUD_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:43365 npm run build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.ts
scripts.package:dmg: node scripts/check-node-version.mjs && rm -rf out release/Soroeru-*.dmg && npm run build:app && npm run build:host && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx playwright install chromium && electron-forge make --platform=darwin && node scripts/rename-dmg.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run poc -- check-egress && npm run poc -- check-persistence && npm run poc -- check-bypass && npm run audit:check
